claims.statement: The BCC import runs as a single asynq task (import:job) handled by bcc_import_worker.go; the pipeline is upload → parse → dedup → label-rate → dispatch → finalize.

Per-format processors (bcc_import_service.go legacy, bcc_import_weekly_bcc.go, bcc_import_weekly_payment.go, bcc_import_multi_position.go, bcc_import_weekly_rates.go) share helpers in bcc_import_pipeline.go that reproduce the original fail/empty/finalize tails and rate-map builders exactly.
buildRateToTarget maps a VND rate to (dayType, hourType); rate is king — on collision the lowest day-type priority wins (prefer "ngày thường") — and posPrefix scopes to position-keyed formats.

BCC imports backdate an existing project_employees assignment's start_date to the file's earliest entry when the upload proves earlier worked days, so same-month uploads are not rejected by assignment validation.
Migration 098 added timesheet_import_jobs.include_flexible_employees (BOOLEAN, default FALSE) so admins can opt flexi-employees into a BCC import.
bcc_import_lock.go serializes BCC imports against concurrent bulk operations on the same project so a half-applied import cannot collide with an in-flight bulk approve.
Successful dispatch writes parsed rows into the timesheet table inside a transaction; on commit, after-commit callbacks fire cache invalidation and event emission per ADR-007.
